title: Collateral Department Note — Land-Use Mix Adjustment to the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage Rate (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
The land-use mix of the parcels still mortgaged moves the rate of a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans) set on the day automatic debit is authorised. The collateral mix adjusts that rate: when irrigated cropland makes up at least half (50 percent) of the appraised value still mortgaged, 0.05 percentage points are taken off; when pasture and recreational land together make up more than half (50 percent) of it, 0.10 percentage points are added; otherwise there is no mix adjustment.

**Measuring the mix.** Each land use's value is the appraised value of the parcels of that land use mortgaged to the loan less those of that land use released from it; the appraised value still mortgaged is every parcel mortgaged less every parcel released. Pasture and recreational land are counted together.

## Adjustment table

| Share of the appraised value still mortgaged | Adjustment to the rate |
|---|---|
| Irrigated cropland 50 percent or more | 0.05 percentage points taken off |
| Pasture and recreational land together more than 50 percent | 0.10 percentage points added |
| Neither | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical parcels, value still mortgaged USD 1000000)

| Irrigated cropland | Pasture and recreational | Other land uses | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 500000 (exactly half) | 300000 | 200000 | 0.05 taken off |
| 499999 | 300000 | 200001 | none |
| 200000 | 500000 (exactly half) | 300000 | none |
| 200000 | 500001 | 299999 | 0.10 added |

A pasture parcel released from the loan no longer counts toward the pasture value, nor toward the value still mortgaged.
